## CrucibleRecipe

```java
public class CrucibleRecipe
```

The original TC4 crucible recipe.

The native port owns the real recipe in `thaumcraft.common.crafting.CrucibleRecipe`; this class keeps the original argument shape and delegates every answer to the native recipe.

Forced 1.21.1 change: an ore-name catalyst became a namespaced item tag, because 1.21.1 has no ore dictionary.

```java
public Object catalyst
public AspectList aspects
public String key
public int hash
```

<a id="cruciblerecipe-cruciblerecipe"></a>
```java
public CrucibleRecipe(String researchKey, ItemStack result, Object cat, AspectList tags)
```

Creates an unregistered recipe, retaining result/tags/catalyst references and hashing essentia-unit costs. Null result/tags throw NPE; catalyst must be a nonempty ItemStack, Item, Block, Ingredient or resolvable item-tag string. Unlike the 1.7.10 Object catalyst shape, ArrayList alternatives are rejected with IAE even though hashing retains that branch. Use Ingredient or a namespaced native item tag for 1.21.1 alternatives; null/unsupported catalysts throw IAE.

## InfusionRecipe

```java
public class InfusionRecipe
```

The original TC4 infusion recipe.

The native port owns the real recipe in `InfusionStackRecipe`; this class keeps the original argument shape and delegates every answer to the native recipe.

Forced 1.21.1 changes: the world became `Level`, the player became `Player` and the original `Object[]` result form became a named native result patch.

```java
protected AspectList aspects
protected String research
protected Object recipeOutput
protected int instability
```

<a id="infusionrecipe-infusionrecipe"></a>
```java
public InfusionRecipe(String research, Object output, int inst, AspectList aspects, ItemStack input, ItemStack[] recipe)
```

Builds an unregistered infusion recipe with dimensionless instability and essentia-unit costs (not centivis). Copies the central input and component array, but retains output/aspects and component stack references; null input throws IAE, null aspects means no native cost, null components means none. The 1.7.10 Object[] NBT-output form now recognizes only ADVANCEDGOLEM, HELMGOGGLES and the three MASK keys; other patch keys throw IAE. In 1.21.1 use named InfusionResultPatches/data-component changes, not arbitrary legacy NBT payloads (additional array values are not general NBT transforms).

<a id="infusionrecipe-nativerecipe"></a>
```java
public InfusionStackRecipe nativeRecipe()
```

The native recipe behind this view.

<a id="infusionrecipe-of"></a>
```java
public static InfusionRecipe of(InfusionStackRecipe recipe)
```

The public view of a native infusion recipe.

Forced 1.21.1 change: the native recipe of the recipe manager is the real one, with its own component predicates and result patches; the view keeps the original argument shape.

<a id="infusionrecipe-matches"></a>
```java
public boolean matches(ArrayList<ItemStack> input, ItemStack central, Level world, Player player)
```

Tests live programmatic fields and virtual getters without consuming supplied stacks. Views of datapack recipes retain native ingredient/patch predicates. Null input/central returns false; null player fails nonempty research gates. Null component entries may throw.

<a id="infusionrecipe-areitemstacksequal"></a>
```java
public static boolean areItemStacksEqual(ItemStack stack0, ItemStack stack1, boolean fuzzy)
```

The original stack comparison.

Forced 1.21.1 change: the original ore-dictionary shortcut has no 1.21.1 equivalent, so the fuzzy flag is ignored entirely. Use native Ingredient/TagKey matching for 1.21.1 equivalence.

Two nulls match, exactly one null does not. Otherwise compares item identity, damage (second-stack damage 32767 is wildcard), and requires the second stack's components in the first; count is ignored and neither stack is changed.

## NativeRecipes

```java
public final class NativeRecipes
```

The native recipe registry behind the public API.

Forced 1.21.1 change: the original kept every recipe of the game in the static list of `ThaumcraftApi`; 1.21.1 keeps the recipes of a world in the recipe manager of the loaded level. The runtime installs that manager through `install(RecipeManager)` and every answer of the public API is read from it.

The native recipes are the real ones; the public API answers with the original views of them (`ShapedArcaneRecipe`, `ShapelessArcaneRecipe`, `CrucibleRecipe`, `InfusionRecipe` and `InfusionEnchantmentRecipe`), exactly as the original published the objects it registered itself.

<a id="nativerecipes-manager"></a>
```java
public static RecipeManager manager()
```

The recipe manager of the loaded level, or null when no level is loaded.

<a id="nativerecipes-registries"></a>
```java
public static HolderLookup.Provider registries()
```

The registry access of the loaded level, or null when no level is loaded.

<a id="nativerecipes-install"></a>
```java
public static void install(RecipeManager manager, HolderLookup.Provider registries)
```

The runtime installs the recipe manager and the registries of the level it loaded.

<a id="nativerecipes-nativerecipes"></a>
```java
public static List<Object> nativeRecipes()
```

Every native recipe of the loaded level, in the order of the recipe manager.

<a id="nativerecipes-views"></a>
```java
public static List<Object> views()
```

Every native recipe of the loaded level as the original public view of it.

<a id="nativerecipes-view"></a>
```java
public static Object view(Object recipe)
```

The original public view of a native recipe.

**Returns:** the view, or null when the native recipe has no original counterpart

```

The aspect list of a native aspect cost.

<a id="nativerecipes-sample"></a>

```

The first item an ingredient accepts; the original recipes named one stack per ingredient.

```

The registry holder of an enchantment, or null when the runtime does not know it.

```

## ShapedArcaneRecipe

```java
public class ShapedArcaneRecipe implements IArcaneRecipe
```

The original TC4 shaped arcane recipe.

The native port owns the real recipe in `ArcaneShapedRecipe`; this class keeps the original argument shape and delegates every answer to the native recipe.

Forced 1.21.1 changes: the inventory became the native `ArcaneRecipeInput` and a recipe argument that names an ore group became a namespaced item tag.

```java
public ItemStack output
public Object[] input
public AspectList aspects
public String research
public int width
public int height
```

<a id="shapedarcanerecipe-shapedarcanerecipe"></a>
```java
public ShapedArcaneRecipe(String research, Block result, AspectList aspects, Object... recipe)
```

Builds an unregistered one-block-result recipe using whole-vis costs; delegates parsing/ownership to the stack constructor, requiring non-null result/recipe.

<a id="shapedarcanerecipe-shapedarcanerecipe-2"></a>
```java
public ShapedArcaneRecipe(String research, Item result, AspectList aspects, Object... recipe)
```

Builds an unregistered one-item-result recipe using whole-vis costs; delegates parsing/ownership to the stack constructor, requiring non-null result/recipe.

<a id="shapedarcanerecipe-shapedarcanerecipe-3"></a>
```java
public ShapedArcaneRecipe(String research, ItemStack result, AspectList aspects, Object... recipe)
```

Parses an unregistered shaped recipe, copying result and retaining nullable research/aspects (whole primal vis, not centivis). Null result/recipe throws NPE; malformed rows/keys/ingredients throw parsing exceptions, including IAE for unsupported ingredients. An optional leading Boolean controls mirroring; character mappings use native ingredients/item tags, not old ore names.

<a id="shapedarcanerecipe-nativerecipe"></a>
```java
public ArcaneShapedRecipe nativeRecipe()
```

The native recipe behind this view; it is rebuilt when the mirroring changes.

<a id="shapedarcanerecipe-of"></a>
```java
public static ShapedArcaneRecipe of(ArcaneShapedRecipe recipe)
```

The public view of a native shaped arcane recipe.

Forced 1.21.1 change: the native recipe of the recipe manager is the real one; the view keeps the original argument shape and answers through it.

<a id="shapedarcanerecipe-getcraftingresult"></a>
```java
public ItemStack getCraftingResult(ArcaneRecipeInput inventory)
```

Returns a fresh assembled result without consuming inventory; inventory is not read by the native assembly path, including null.

<a id="shapedarcanerecipe-getrecipesize"></a>
```java
public int getRecipeSize()
```

Returns the live input-array length in grid cells (including blanks); a public-field null assignment throws NPE.

<a id="shapedarcanerecipe-getrecipeoutput"></a>
```java
public ItemStack getRecipeOutput()
```

Returns the live nullable public output reference, not the independent native assembly result.

<a id="shapedarcanerecipe-matches"></a>
```java
public boolean matches(ArcaneRecipeInput inventory, Level level, Player player)
```

Tests research and translated/mirrored grid predicates without spending vis or items; may lazily cache the native recipe. Inventory must be non-null (native matching may throw otherwise); level is unused by matching, and null player fails a nonempty research gate.

<a id="shapedarcanerecipe-setmirrored"></a>
```java
public ShapedArcaneRecipe setMirrored(boolean mirror)
```

Sets horizontal-mirroring permission and returns this; the native recipe is rebuilt lazily on next access.

<a id="shapedarcanerecipe-checkitemequals"></a>
```java
protected boolean checkItemEquals(ItemStack stack0, ItemStack stack1)
```

The original comparison of two ingredient stacks.

Original `thaumcraft/api/crafting/ShapedArcaneRecipe.java`: two stacks are the same when they are the same item, when their tags are equal and when their damage values are equal; the wildcard damage of the recipe accepts every damage of the item.

Forced 1.21.1 change: the Forge ore dictionary of the original has no 1.21.1 counterpart, so the shortcut of the original is gone; the tags are compared with the native data components.

<a id="shapedarcanerecipe-getinput"></a>
```java
public Object[] getInput()
```

The original ingredient cells of the pattern; a blank cell is null.

<a id="shapedarcanerecipe-getaspects"></a>
```java
public AspectList getAspects()
```

Returns the live nullable primal vis-cost list in whole vis, not centivis; no copy is made.

<a id="shapedarcanerecipe-getaspects-2"></a>
```java
public AspectList getAspects(ArcaneRecipeInput inventory)
```

Returns the live nullable whole-vis cost list, ignoring inventory including null; no mutation occurs.

<a id="shapedarcanerecipe-getresearch"></a>
```java
public String getResearch()
```

Returns the stored nullable research key without mutation.
